title: Why we are opening the conversation
reader_question: What will Seafood Confidential offer, who is behind it, and how can readers contribute?
source_requirements: Both founders approve their biographies, relevant interests, editorial promise and contribution route.
newsletter: One weekly dispatch introducing the publication and inviting reader questions.
social: Up to 3 LinkedIn posts: publication introduction; one founder perspective; one question for industry readers.
podcast: No episode required. Optional short founder introduction only if production is owned.

title: What the price of a fish actually includes
owner: Paul Phillips with invited trade sources
reader_question: Which costs and decisions should a buyer understand when comparing landed and delivered prices?
source_requirements: Buyer, seller and logistics perspectives; permissioned real figures or an explicitly illustrative calculation; units, dates and assumptions.
newsletter: One weekly dispatch linking the feature and 2-3 attributed relevant sources.
social: Up to 3 LinkedIn posts: main insight; checked cost-chain graphic; a buyer question.

title: The work behind a shrimp farm
owner: Invited aquaculture practitioner; guest to be selected
reader_question: Which practical decisions shape an ordinary working day on this particular farm?
source_requirements: Choose an operation the team can genuinely access; verify place and production context; record affiliation, permissioned photos and claim evidence. Substitute another farm type if access makes it stronger.
newsletter: One weekly dispatch introducing the guest and asking what readers want explained about aquaculture.
social: Up to 3 LinkedIn posts: field insight; permissioned photo sequence; a farm-practice question.

title: Better questions to ask about wild and farmed seafood
owner: Paul Phillips with invited fishery and aquaculture voices
reader_question: Which questions reveal meaningful differences in species, place, production and sourcing?
source_requirements: Producer perspectives from both systems; primary sources for technical claims; clear scope and relevant interests.
newsletter: One weekly dispatch highlighting practical comparison questions and inviting examples.
social: Up to 3 LinkedIn posts: one comparison question; a checked excerpt or captioned clip; one practitioner discussion prompt.
podcast: Optional monthly pilot only with named production owner and permissions; its adapted feature replaces the weekly article. Audio editing is additional capacity.

title: A rule on paper and a working day on the water
owner: Managing editor with invited local practitioner
editor: Named human editor assigned before commissioning
reader_question: What does one verified rule require, and how does it affect the people doing the work?
source_requirements: One current official source; jurisdiction, authority, status and effective date; last status check; operator experience distinguished from formal requirements.
newsletter: One weekly dispatch explaining who is affected and linking the official source.
social: Up to 3 LinkedIn posts: the defined question; source-linked status card; a practical implementation question.

title: The fishmonger and the chef
owner: Paul Phillips with two invited practitioners
reader_question: How do buying, yield, substitutions and menu choices connect the trade with the plate?
source_requirements: Two verified roles and affiliations; recording/publication terms; checked quotations; sources for handling or safety claims.
newsletter: One weekly dispatch connecting trade choices with food and inviting the next contributor.
social: Up to 3 LinkedIn posts: one practical insight; approved quotation or image; a chef or buyer question.
podcast: Written conversation by default. Audio only if it fits the agreed monthly cadence and production capacity.
